newsitem.title: UK: Regalian in Paddington development talks.
newsitem.headline: Regalian in Paddington development talks.

text.p: Regalian Properties Plc said on Wednesday that it is in preliminary talks about the development of part of the first phase of a site at Paddington station in London.
The property development company, which already has around one third of the Paddington site, was making the statement in response to the recent sharp rise in its share price.

"Apparently there are rumours that we are talking about a big prelet on the site so therefore we have had to put out this statement that says, yes, we are in very preliminary discussions, but it is no more than that," Bob Perdeaux, finance director of Regalian, told Reuters.
Regalian's share price was unchanged on the day at 41-1/4p by 0935 GMT, but has risen 6-1/4p since February 21.
